bind_ip.name: Local Bind Address
bind_ip.description: Local interface to bind. 0.0.0.0 binds every interface.
bind_ip.description_zh: 绑定的本地网卡地址，0.0.0.0 表示绑定所有网卡。

bind_port.name: Local Bind Port
bind_port.description: Devices commonly broadcast their I-Am to 47808 instead of replying to the source port, so binding 47808 is required to see those replies.
bind_port.description_zh: 设备通常将 I-Am 广播到 47808 端口而非回复至源端口，因此需绑定 47808 才能收到应答。

device_scan_interval.name: Device Scan Interval
device_scan_interval.description: How often to sweep the network for devices, in seconds.
device_scan_interval.description_zh: 定时扫描设备的周期（秒）。

point_scan_interval.name: Point Scan Interval
point_scan_interval.description: How often to re-enumerate the points of every known device, in seconds. Far more expensive than a device sweep - one request per object - so normally the longer of the two.
point_scan_interval.description_zh: 定时扫描已发现设备点位的周期（秒）。点位扫描每个对象需一次请求，开销远大于设备扫描，通常设置得比设备扫描周期长。

local_broadcast.name: Local Broadcast Scan
local_broadcast.description: Send Who-Is as an Original-Broadcast-NPDU. Reaches devices on the local IP subnet.
local_broadcast.description_zh: 以 Original-Broadcast-NPDU 发送 Who-Is，可发现本地 IP 子网内的设备。

global_broadcast.name: Global Broadcast Scan
global_broadcast.description: Send Who-Is with DNET 0xFFFF so BACnet routers forward it. Reaches devices on MS/TP or other networks behind a router.
global_broadcast.description_zh: 以 DNET 0xFFFF 发送 Who-Is，BACnet 路由器会向所有直连网络转发，可发现挂在 MS/TP 等网络后面的设备。

broadcast_ip.name: Broadcast Address
broadcast_ip.description: Destination of both broadcast modes. A subnet-directed address such as 192.168.1.255 is preferred over 255.255.255.255.
broadcast_ip.description_zh: 两种广播模式的目标地址，建议使用子网定向广播地址（如 192.168.1.255）而非 255.255.255.255。

bbmd_enable.name: Scan via BBMD
bbmd_enable.description: Register as a foreign device with a BBMD and send Who-Is as Distribute-Broadcast-To-Network. Reaches the other IP subnets that make up the same B/IP network.
bbmd_enable.description_zh: 向 BBMD 注册为外部设备，并以 Distribute-Broadcast-To-Network 发送 Who-Is，可发现同一 B/IP 网络中其他 IP 子网的设备。
